messages:
rita: Heads up — intermittent duplicate POSTs from the Java sample during onboarding when toggling networks quickly (wifi->lte). Seen on Pixel 6/Android 14 and Pixel 8/15.

rita: Auth flow uses a blocking TokenStore.getToken() inside an OkHttp interceptor. No custom CallAdapter.

rita: Log excerpt: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/work id=202
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 /v1/work id=202
I/TokenStore: refresh start
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/work id=202 <- duplicate enqueue
I/TokenStore: refresh done
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/work id=203 (retry)
```

omar: Any minify/R8 on debug builds? We've had R8-change timing issues before with coroutine bridges.

rita: Good catch — debug had minify enabled accidentally. Turning it off in debug cut dupes to near-zero locally.

vince: Short-term: disable minify for debug and add a proguard keep for auth classes. Medium: implement single-flight token refresh (dedupe inflight), ensure shared OkHttpClient and fresh Request objects.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/210 with APKs/logs. Nightly harness to pair with eng-runtime being scheduled.

rita: Will push a small README patch and temporary keep rules. Thanks.
